question: Who revealed this renowned teaching among moving and unmoving things?
premises: The teaching is in this renowned text.
It concerns moving and unmoving things.
It was revealed by Brahmā alone.
inference: The verse attributes revelation of this teaching to Brahmā alone.
uncertainties: The exact teaching is not specified.
plain_english: In this renowned teaching among moving and unmoving things, revealed by Brahmā alone.
